amount.note: Listed as a one-time fee under Revised Code 111.16(F) in the Legislative Service Commission's list of Secretary of State fees.

annual.label: Annual report fee
annual.due: No annual report is listed for LLCs.

sources.title: Ohio Legislative Service Commission - Secretary of State agency fees, January 30, 2026 (PDF)

amount.note: The fee list shows no annual or biennial report fee for LLCs, but we could not open a Secretary of State page that says so directly (the site shows a security check). Not counted until confirmed.

notIncluded.label: Registered agent service
notIncluded.reason: Only if you hire a registered agent. The agent sets the price, so it is not a state fee and is not in the total.

notIncluded.label: Name reservation
notIncluded.reason: Optional. Reserving a name before you file is a separate charge and is not in the total.

notIncluded.label: Expedited filing and certified copies
notIncluded.reason: Optional. Faster processing and certified copies cost extra and are not in the total.

notIncluded.label: Local business licenses and permits
notIncluded.reason: City, county and industry licenses depend on where the business operates and what it does. None are in the total.

notIncluded.label: Federal and state income taxes
notIncluded.reason: Taxes on the LLC's or its owners' income are not part of this estimate. This page is not legal or tax advice.

content.intro: {state} charges a one-time fee to file Articles of Organization. We are still confirming whether any yearly state filing applies.

howItWorks.text: The Legislative Service Commission's list of Secretary of State fees gives the one-time fee for filing articles of organization for an LLC.

faq.q: Is the {state} filing fee charged every year?
faq.text: No. The Legislative Service Commission lists the fee for filing articles of organization as a one-time fee.
